description: This Java source file defines a utility class 'Beta' in the 'org.apache.commons.math3.special' package, providing methods for computing the regularized beta function, beta function logarithm, and related special functions. It includes algorithms based on scholarly references and library implementations for accurate numerical computation of beta-related functions.

classes.name: Beta
classes.description: A utility class for computing beta functions and related special functions, including regularized beta and logarithm of the beta function.

methods.name: regularizedBeta
methods.description: Computes the regularized incomplete beta function I(x, a, b) with various overloads supporting default parameters and convergence controls.

methods.name: logBeta
methods.description: Calculates the natural logarithm of the beta function B(p, q).
